home.title: Sign in once, prove every platform
home.statement: CP OAuth is an OAuth 2.0 provider for competitive programmers. Link and verify your Luogu, AtCoder, LeetCode, Codeforces and other accounts, then approve what apps can read.

about.title: About CP OAuth

proof.luogu: Verified with a code in a public Luogu clipboard.
proof.atcoder: Verified with a code in the AtCoder profile Affiliation.
proof.leetcode: Verified with a code in the leetcode.cn profile bio.

about.flowText: Standard OAuth 2.0 with optional PKCE (S256 or plain).

steps.register: Create an OAuth client in the developer console with exact redirect URIs.
steps.redirect: Send the user to the authorization endpoint with client_id, redirect_uri, response_type=code, scope, state, and PKCE code_challenge for public clients.
steps.consent: After sign-in and consent, the browser returns to your redirect URI with a 10-minute code.
steps.exchange: Exchange the code at the token endpoint for a 1-hour access token and a 30-day refresh token.
steps.userinfo: Call the userinfo endpoint with the bearer token to read granted scopes.
steps.refresh: Use the refresh token to obtain new tokens; each refresh token rotates on use.
